title: store unfinished cleared
description: What <app> store unfinished clear <thing> answers with -o json once a person said yes: the marks it removed, so changes to the keys they held are made again. Clearing puts nothing back; each journal stays where it is, this user's shown as left by <app> store unfinished list (ADR-S22, G-STACK-13).

kind.description: Always StoreUnfinishedCleared, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

data.description: The thing asked for and the changes whose marks were removed.

thing.description: The thing whose changes cut short were cleared: a key's first step, as the unfinished_change refusal names it.

cleared.description: Each change whose marks were removed, as it was before; file names this user's journal, which stays. Never empty: clearing a thing no mark holds is not_found, so nothing is cleared by a typo.
